about_the_game:
🎮Developed by a Brazilian indie developer, Reng Azure: Requiem is a 2D pixel art action RPG that combines unique tactical combat using 4-directional teleportation and an epic narrative of survival and redemption.

RENG AZURE: REQUIEM

In a world on the brink of collapse, you are the last hope.

Control Reng Azure, a warrior resurrected by Termotellas, the guardian of souls. Manipulate space time to teleport in the midst of combat, explore ancient ruins through dimensional portals and face dark forces that threaten existence.

Resurrected with a frozen soul, you must constantly warm your spiritual essence at sacred bonfires or you will succumb to the eternal void. In Tartarius, where condemned souls wander in search of freedom, you must eliminate the fugitives while keeping your own existence burning.

Guided by your mentor in raven form, discover the ancestral secrets, find the 7 master keys and release the fearsome Tartariuno in a final confrontation that will decide the fate of your reborn soul.

Each choice shapes your destiny in this journey of redemption, survival and power. Keep your soul warm. Stay alive.

FEATURES

UNIQUE TACTICAL COMBAT

- Teleportation in 4 directions - No traditional jump, only pure strategy and precise positioning

- Fluid combat system with attack, defense and temporal dodge

- Master space time and annihilate your enemies with precision

SUPERNATURAL POWERS

- Raven Summoning - Summon a winged ally for devastating attacks

- Raven Transformation - Fly through the skies and explore inaccessible perspectives

PROGRESSION AND CUSTOMIZATION

- Deep upgrade system - Evolve speed, damage, spiritual resistance and special abilities

- Each death is a lesson - Learn, adapt and become stronger

- Multiple evolution paths for your playstyle

SOUL SURVIVAL

- Warm your resurrected soul at sacred bonfires or fade into the void

- Manage spiritual heat while exploring Tartarius

- Each step is a bet between exploration and definitive extinction

DARK AND ATMOSPHERIC WORLD

- Dark and detailed pixel art that brings Tartarius to life

- Fragmented worlds interconnected by dimensional portals

EPIC NARRATIVE

- Story of redemption in a collapsing universe

- Multiple languages supported for players from around the world

YOUR JOURNEY BEGINS NOW

Among the dark dimensions of Tartarius, where time bends and reality fragments, only those with incandescent souls survive. Do you have what it takes to keep your essence burning, defy destiny, defeat the Tartariuno and save your reborn soul?

The flame of life can still burn eternally. The universe awaits its resurrected hero.

Your Requiem is just beginning...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 +
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 compatible
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Pixel art action RPG with Metroidvania and Soulslike elements. Seven master keys seal your fate. Teleport through dark worlds, face ancient guardians, explore secret locations and evolve your soul alongside your protective crow.
supported_languages: English, French, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil, Italian, German, Korean, Japanese, Russian
